title: SceneBench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Vision-Language Understanding of 3D Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2609.16233v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models excel at 2D image understanding but remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Progress is hindered by limitations in current benchmarks. First, 3D datasets often rely on point clouds that capture geometry but discard rich visual features like texture, text, and materials. Second, annotations treat objects in isolation while ignoring real-world hierarchical organization (scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups). Third, evaluation tasks focus narrowly on basic recognition rather than multi-step spatial reasoning.   In this context, we introduce SceneBench, a benchmark of 966 photorealistic 3D scenes reconstructed with Gaussian Splatting and densely annotated with hierarchical semantics spanning scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups, and individual objects. translated_title: SceneBench：面向3D场景视觉-语言理解的层次化基准测试
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型在2D图像理解方面表现出色，但在3D空间推理方面仍然受限。其进展受到当前基准测试局限性的阻碍。首先，3D数据集通常依赖点云，虽能捕捉几何结构，却丢弃了纹理、文字和材质等丰富的视觉特征。其次，现有标注孤立地处理各个对象，忽略了现实世界中场景、房间、功能区域、对象组等层次化组织结构。第三，评估任务狭窄地聚焦于基础识别，而非多步骤空间推理。在此背景下，我们提出了SceneBench，这是一个包含966个通过高斯泼溅重建的逼真3D场景的基准测试，并对场景、房间、功能区域、对象组和单个对象进行了密集的层次化语义标注。这些标注通过人机协同流水线生成，结合了视觉-语言模型与约1,500小时的人工迭代审校。
tldr: SceneBench是一个包含966个基于高斯泼溅重建的逼真3D场景的层次化基准测试，通过人机协同流水线进行密集的层次化语义标注，克服了现有3D基准在视觉特征、层次化组织和多步骤空间推理方面的不足。
en_tdlr: SceneBench is a hierarchical benchmark of 966 photorealistic 3D scenes reconstructed with Gaussian Splatting, densely annotated with hierarchical semantics through a human-in-the-loop pipeline, addressing the limitations of existing 3D benchmarks in visual features, hierarchical organization, and multi-step spatial reasoning.
